verdict.rationale: Queries let you define criteria and get an instantly updated View of matching Objects. The docs describe the app as offline-first, with all content stored locally and the local API running fully offline. The agents toolkit can also search Objects. However, the evidence never explicitly documents full-text search across note bodies in the app, or filtering by tags, properties, or paths. Missing for 10: explicit full-text content search documentation, documented tag/property filter operators, path/folder-based filtering, independent hands-on confirmation of search speed and offline search.
